name: ucri1-test-client
description: UCRI 1.x Test-Client (Angular + ng-zorro, NestJS) – eine Anwendung, ein Prozess

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -k -n ui,api "npm run watch -w frontend" "npm run start:dev -w backend"
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm test -w shared && npm test -w backend && npm run test:e2e -w backend && npm test -w frontend -- --watch=false
